# Synthetic event-log fixtures

All files in this directory are synthetic. They are not real exchange data,
not Binance data and not benchmark data.

The fixtures exist only to test canonical local event-log storage,
deterministic replay into snapshots and replay-to-feature or replay-to-label
integration. They must not be presented as evidence of market behaviour,
forecast quality or trading performance.

The files are deliberately tiny so they remain easy to audit by eye.
